andrew ranxx.bio: Andrew Ranxx is the earlier recording name of Toronto-raised reggae singer and deejay Andrew White, now known as Akustix. Born in St. Elizabeth, Jamaica and raised in Toronto, he became part of Canada's reggae scene in the 1990s, later earning a JUNO nomination as Akustix and continuing to record and write reggae music.

kwncy.bio: Kwncy is a Toronto-born and raised singer-songwriter whose music blends alternative R&B, neo-soul and lo-fi pop. Her catalogue includes CROOKED, DOWNTOWN, Territorial and the 2026 project St Lucie Drive, alongside collaborations with Canadian artists including DijahSB and RUSSELL!.

papi aq.bio: Papi AQ is a Mexican-born, Toronto-based Latin-Canadian singer and rapper who moved to Canada in the early 2000s. Performing in English and Spanish, he developed a self-described Spanglish sound shaped by his Toronto upbringing and has built a catalogue spanning hip-hop, trap, R&B and Latin music through releases including BODMON, Rumba and Keys to My City.

richie sosa.bio: Richie Sosa is a Canadian rapper from Toronto's east end whose career helped shape the city's pre-breakthrough mixtape era. Born Omar West Forbes and raised in East Scarborough, he built a prolific independent catalogue, wrote for producer Boi-1da and collaborated with Drake on Easy to Please from the 2007 mixtape Comeback Season.

sazon diamante.bio: Sazon Diamante was an East Vancouver rapper and an early Latin voice in Canadian hip-hop. A childhood friend and collaborator of Concise and the younger brother of Rascalz producer DJ Kemo, he appeared with the Rascalz and Notch on the 2002 single Crazy World before his death, leaving a lasting connection to Vancouver's hip-hop history.
